archive.catalogue_description: Santas Little Secret at the start of the competition we hit a huge error which took up 98% of the time we had to make the map and unfortanlty due to mine and Yonkers lack scripting ment no good eater egg the story did not turn out the way we wanted but were are planning a remake:) Story line: It is 5 day before Christmas the world has been infested with zombies a global out brake tears the world apart but fortunately before Santa be came well you know a Z he predicted the apocalypses and decided to make a nuke containing the T gas to save the world well what remained of it so he sent a letter to you because he knew your are the ones that could finish the mission to complete his quest you must investigate his factory and find location of the nuke and launch it can you do it the world is counting on you good luck solider’s Normal Version Features: Features: – GrantDaddy007 freeze gun script – custom view hands made by me – Boss zombie – Jug fix – 9 perks – wonderfizz – buyable ending – insta-kill removed – no dogs – Custom load screen’s – all custom weaponry – Custom gun and equipment textures – Christmas hud – zombie counter – soul box – teleporters – easter egg – custom zombies UGX Version Features: UGXMOD GrantDaddy007 monkey and freeze gun script custom view hands made buy Yonkers his self 🙂 Soul chest a end game YAW Play through of our map http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m46Gq3iuXTc#ws Credits: me and Yonkers GrantDaddy007 You always win treminaor and the whole team
